- **2–13s:** Three gently moving studio close-ups: the full bottle, loop cap, and matte-black body/base.
- **13–15s:** “Shop now” on a matching end card.
- **Vertical 9:16, 480p**, mellow instrumental music, no talking.

Your photo would guide all three shots. AI generation can still alter small product details, so I can’t guarantee an exact match.
